description: The AI watches the Q4 forecast, the training cohort, and the overtime trajectory across every care queue and brand, surfacing the surge gap before it lands — 5 days of warning, not a Monday-morning surprise.

Ask about the surge and get a sourced answer that blends 3 years of Snowflake history, the current schedule, and the planned Q4 campaigns — the cross-system correlation the contact center platform cannot produce alone.

Model staffing scenarios conversationally — overtime shifts, BPO overflow, self-service deflection — and the AI projects the service-level impact and budget cost of each, so you close the gap with the cheapest path that holds.

The AI maps where the new-hire cohort gets stuck — the knowledge-base gaps in hosting and domain troubleshooting, the guided-flow skips — so you know exactly why the ramp is behind and whether they can carry peak volume.
